title: A High-Resolution Spatial and Sectoral Natural Gas Demand Disaggregation Benchmark for the Sicilian Transmission Grid
description: An open-access benchmark dataset and mathematical methodology providing hourly natural gas demand profiles for all 167 delivery stations (Cabine Re.Mi. and major industrial poles) across the 9 administrative provinces of Sicily, Italy. Integrates ISTAT municipal boundaries, SNAM contractual delivery capacities, MASE 2024 annual sectoral statistics, and TERNA measured CCGT generation calibrated via a 3-harmonic Fourier series.
